constraints: In the targetObj syntax, passing a subsection or an anchored picture raises an error; only a range or element (table/row/paragraph/body/text box/header/footer) is accepted.

If targetObj is or belongs to a header/footer, the section to which that header/footer is attached is returned; if it is or belongs to a text box, the first section is returned unless the text box is anchored to a section.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the first section intersected by the given range or element (targetObj).
Returns the section corresponding to sectionIndex within wpDoc.
